root_cause.text: `macvlan_common_newlink()` can make a newly created `net_device` visible to RCU readers before detecting an error, but the error path immediately frees the device without waiting for an RCU grace period, leading to a use-after-free in concurrent readers.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `synchronize_net()` to the end of `macvlan_common_newlink()` to ensure an RCU grace period is observed before the caller (`rtnl_newlink()`) frees the device, preventing a slab-use-after-free in `macvlan_forward_source`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Call synchronize_net() on the error path of macvlan_common_newlink to prevent use-after-free of a temporarily visible net_device.
intent_record.what: Added a call to synchronize_net() along with an explanatory comment before returning the error code in macvlan_common_newlink.
intent_record.how: It ensures an RCU grace period is observed before the caller frees the net_device, preventing potential use-after-free issues if the device became briefly visible before the error occurred.
